title: workflow/1.0/advance
description: Fires an event on an instance: guard, optional action, persisted state, and complete on reaching a final state. Idempotent per idempotency_key. Answered with a status or a problem-report. (didcomm.org workflow/1.0)

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. REQUIRED when the message is authcrypted.

thid.description: Thread id; the id of the message that started the thread.

instance_id.description: The workflow instance's id. The thread id MUST equal it.

event.description: A transitions[].on of the current state.

input.description: Form values by form-id; for state:set@1 actions, merged into context.

$transient.description: input fields used for this advance only, never stored.
